title.en: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE PERFORMANCE BY THE SUPERINTENDENT OF INTERISLAND TRANSPORTATION OF THE DUTIES HERETOFORE PERFORMED BY THE PURCHASING1 AGENT IN THE MATTER OF TRANSPORTATION FOR OFFICIALS AND EMPLOYEES OF THE GOVERNMENT.
title.orig: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE PERFORMANCE BY THE SUPERINTENDENT OF INTERISLAND TRANSPORTATION OF THE DUTIES HERETOFORE PERFORMED BY THE PURCHASING1 AGENT IN THE MATTER OF TRANSPORTATION FOR OFFICIALS AND EMPLOYEES OF THE GOVERNMENT.

text.en:
All of the duties which heretofore pertained to the Purchasing Agent in the matter of
transportation for officials and employees of the Government from one point to another in the Islands, shall
be performed by the Superintendent of Interisland Transportation after the dale of the passage of this Act,
and section eight of Act Numbered One hundred and ninety-eight, as amended, is hereby further amended in
so far as may be necessary to give effect to this provision.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of lavs." passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, November 29, 1905.
